## {{< fa code-branch >}} Build information {.smaller}

```{r build-info-setup, echo=FALSE}
# Included as a deck's last slide via Quarto's include shortcode.
# CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME (GitLab CI, detached HEAD) or GITHUB_REF_NAME
# (GitHub Actions) names the branch in CI; falls back to the local git
# checkout when rendering on a laptop.
get_build_info <- function(stale_days = 30) {
  git <- function(...) tryCatch(
    system2("git", c(...), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE),
    error = function(e) character(0)
  )

  branch <- Sys.getenv("CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME", unset = Sys.getenv("GITHUB_REF_NAME", unset = NA))
  if (is.na(branch) || !nzchar(branch)) branch <- git("rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD")
  branch <- if (length(branch) == 0 || !nzchar(branch[1])) "unknown" else branch[1]

  sha <- git("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD")
  sha <- if (length(sha) == 0) "unknown" else sha[1]

  dirty <- length(git("status", "--porcelain")) > 0

  last_commit_ts <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(git("log", "-1", "--format=%ct")))
  last_commit_date <- if (length(last_commit_ts) == 0 || is.na(last_commit_ts[1])) {
    NA
  } else {
    as.POSIXct(last_commit_ts[1], origin = "1970-01-01")
  }
  age_days <- if (inherits(last_commit_date, "POSIXct")) {
    as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), last_commit_date, units = "days"))
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  # "stale" = not the main branch, or main hasn't moved in a while
  is_stale <- branch != "main" || (!is.na(age_days) && age_days > stale_days)

  list(branch = branch, sha = sha, dirty = dirty,
       last_commit_date = last_commit_date, age_days = age_days, is_stale = is_stale)
}
```

```{r build-info-oneline, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
info <- get_build_info()
status <- if (info$is_stale) "⚠️ stale" else "current"

cat(glue::glue(
  "Branch `{info$branch}` ({status}) &middot; ",
  "Commit `{info$sha}`{if (info$dirty) ' (dirty)' else ''} &middot; ",
  "Built {format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')} &middot; ",
  "{Sys.info()[['sysname']]}"
))
```
